recipe.visualDefinition: A theatrical 1970s glam rock aesthetic featuring a central performer in a dramatic pose, framed by geometric borders and high-contrast typography, including a vertical Japanese-style information strip (obi).
coreVisualRelationships: The performer's dynamic gesture breaks the inner frame to create depth.
The vertical black obi strip anchors the left side against the cream background.
Gold script lettering contrasts with the sharp geometric lines of the framing.
Warm, stage-lit subject against a cool-toned, multi-layered border system.
coreInvariants: Multi-line green and gold geometric frame
Vertical black sidebar with white and gold text
High-contrast stage photography with deep shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-shot, slightly angled, occupying 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical black obi strip on the far left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold vertical strip on the left, across the performer's outstretched arm, to the gold script at the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous cream-colored margins surrounding the central framed image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background providing a vintage paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the obi strip and shadows of the photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold for script and borders; forest green for geometric framing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast photography with low-saturation background and high-saturation metallic accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cream, gold, green, and black

letterConstructionRules: Top script: High-slant, connected cursive with thick-to-thin stroke variation.
Bottom text: Wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif with inline or outlined details.
Obi text: Vertical orientation, mixing bold sans-serif and traditional characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature elongated, flourishing ascenders and descenders.
Bottom letters have a distinct 'inline' hollow effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of expressive, organic script with rigid, wide-spaced geometric forms.

preserve: Vertical layout of the left strip

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Display or ITC Avant Garde
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric foundation for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1970s album cover layout. A cream-textured paper background. On the left, a solid black vertical strip. In the center, a forest green and gold double-line rectangular frame. Inside the frame, place a theatrical photo of a glam rock performer in a sequined jacket, mid-performance with dramatic stage lighting and deep shadows. The performer's hand should slightly overlap the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add gold metallic script text tilted upwards in the top right corner with a thin black outline. Add wide-spaced, gold geometric uppercase text at the bottom center with an inline effect. Fill the left black strip with vertical white and gold technical-style typography.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm cream texture?
Does the performer's pose feel theatrical and dynamic?
Is the vertical obi strip present on the left edge?
Are the borders geometric and multi-layered?

adjustableVariables: Color of the geometric frame (e.g., blue instead of green)
Intensity of the metallic gold effect
Subject matter of the central photograph
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos

mustAchieve: Theatrical lighting in the subject photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text is legible despite the tilt.
Check that the obi strip doesn't crowd the central image.
Verify the 'inline' effect on the bottom text is crisp.
Confirm the grain/texture is consistent across the cream areas.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Glam Layout = (Cream Texture + Black Obi Strip) + (Geometric Frame x 2) + (Theatrical Stage Photo) + (Gold Script / Wide Geometric Sans)
